notes.title: 23th October, Major update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30366159/02b54683c3e05e9d81772690c38477dbdd3ac735.gif[/img]

Hi everyone,

We are pleased to announce that we are finally updating new contents for Toy Clash. [b]There are 16 new stages decorated in a volcanic theme, with 4 new enemy characters including a gigantic boss monster. And one more thing, you now can see the ending scene at the end of the game![/b]

But these are not the final contents you will have in Toy Clash. We are also working on more contents for future updates, so I hope you enjoy our recent new update until we bring you another one!
